question: Brief me for the 10:00 Nordvik redline call

intro.title: Meet Jonas's workspace
intro.text: Jonas Lindqvist, Enterprise Sales Manager, Stockholm. Eight tools, six reps, a $6.8M Q3 quota — one screen runs all of it.

hero.title: The day's one job
hero.text: The brief cuts straight to it: turn Nordvik's round-2 redlines today. OPP-4821, $1.2M, must sign by Aug 21 to keep Q3 on pace.

kpis.title: The numbers, live
kpis.text: Q3 attainment: 48.2%, up 6.4 points on Q2. Nine deals worth $3.4M closing in August — pulled from Salesforce, no spreadsheet in sight.

chart.title: Twelve months, one story
chart.text: June hit 127% of target on the Nordvik pilot; July dipped to 83% post-quarter. August already has $1.42M booked.

ask.title: Drag it, ask it
ask.text: Jonas drags a KPI into chat and asks for the 10:00 Nordvik brief. Watch it pull Salesforce, Gmail, and Drive in seconds.

delegate.title: Hand off the chasing
delegate.text: One click chases the Aventra security questionnaire. Laura Simmons commits to Aug 12 — the $840K September signature stays alive.

autopilot.title: Approvals on autopilot
autopilot.text: Flip the switch: routine PTO and expenses clear themselves. The 18% Trellis discount and Nordvik cap language still wait for Jonas.

mcp.title: Under the hood
mcp.text: The MCP console shows the wiring: Salesforce, DocuSign, Gmail and more, connected live. Every answer traces back to a real system.

recap.title: Friday, in one click
recap.text: One click writes the week: Caldera signed at $290K, commit up $310K, slip risks flagged. Claire's report, done before coffee.

outro.title: More selling, less admin
outro.text: The pipeline runs itself; Jonas runs the deals. That's a $1.2M signature closer by Friday — and this is just one seat.
